title: 2008 AMC 10B Problem 24
statement: Quadrilateral \(ABCD\) has \(AB=BC=CD,\) \(\angle ABC=70^\circ,\) and \(\angle BCD=170^\circ.\) What is the degree measure of \(\angle BAD?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(M\) be the point with \(\triangle BMC\) equilateral, on the same side of \(BC\) as \(A.\) Then \(\angle ABM=70^\circ-60^\circ=10^\circ\) and \(\angle MCD=170^\circ-60^\circ=110^\circ.\)

Since \(AB=BM\) and \(MC=CD,\) triangles \(ABM\) and \(MCD\) are isosceles, giving \(\angle AMB=85^\circ\) and \(\angle CMD=35^\circ.\)

Then \(\angle AMD=360^\circ-85^\circ-60^\circ\) \(-35^\circ\) \(=180^\circ,\) so \(M\) lies on \(\overline{AD}\) and \(\angle BAD=\angle BAM=85^\circ.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Build an equilateral triangle \(BMC\) on the same side of \(BC\) as \(A\)
Show \(\triangle ABM\) and \(\triangle MCD\) are isosceles, then prove \(M\) lies on \(\overline{AD}\)
